title: Durable job state integrity
purpose: Harden durable job state and validation correctness; fix defects found during the user-authorized continuing codebase improvement pass.

included: Atomic in-memory job updates after successful validation and persistence
Detach caller-owned payloads from stored jobs
Enforce nullable container constraints in runtime and Benchmark Lab validators
Reject non-finite numbers and enforce oneOf sibling constraints in runtime validation
Expose actionable schema failure evidence in the existing validation console
Preserve explicit failed results and zero scores in console history; identify demo runs correctly
excluded: New product features, benchmark qualification, and delivery
Roadmap changes; this is an ad hoc maintenance slice authorized by the user
